scope: Refitted the four preparation pipelines, the majority baseline, every fitted statistic, all 86 transformed held-out rows, the practice missing-mass coordinate, the unknown/missing category policies, the five-value scaler fixture, the six-row cross-fitting table and the three-donor KNN imputation from the packet's CSV, and matched each against calculated-inputs.json before generating src/learn/data/scaling-data.js.
limitations: One fixed stratified split of one curated collection; not a sampling study.
Numerical results can differ on other library versions.
Two rows lack every measurement and eleven lack recorded sex; both are carried through, not dropped.
